notes.title: Towercore Survivors - Update V0.1.35 Now Available
notes.content:
🔥 The tower won't fall as long as one Guardian stands!

After a long wait... Towercore: Survivors V0.1.35 is finally here! Get ready for a more intense and refined experience with these updates:

--------


🆕 New Content

- 🗺️ New Level: Level 9 unlocked, packed with fresh challenges.
- 👁️ 7 New Visions: Unveil the mistery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709562/059d93bcd99b57e9bfe5b83864ea8dc6bd102349.png[/img]

--------

🗓️Changelog:

- New Feature: Level 9
- Bug Id 049 (Playing): Walking animation and Guardian movement.
- Bug Id 130 (Playing): The player animation looks like the idle pose all the time.
- Bug Id 172 (Playing): Some chests or treasures disappear when hit by a sword or an ice shard. I don’t think that should happen.
- Bug Id 175 (Playing): The control counter at the top of the screen is not very visible. Maybe it's intentional in this type of game, but I think it should be more appealing and easier to see — some players do constantly check the stats.
- Bug Id 176 (Playing): I would add a bit more color to the game. There are too many gray and black tones. I think some bright colors here and there could make it more lively.
- Bug Id 178 (Playing): I feel like the graphics’ sprites look too blocky. Maybe that’s the style of this kind of game, I don’t know — but I think it’s worth reconsidering.
- Bug Id 191 (Idle): On the start screen, pressing ESC opens the roadmap instead of exiting the game.
- Bug Id 194 (Playing): The character moves a bit slower.
- Bug Id 195 (Playing): The damaging aura sound is very heavy/annoying.
- Bug Id 196 (Playing): When experience points are collected with a magnet, they move very slowly.
- Bug Id 203 (Playing): More chests are needed to level up.
- Bug Id 208 (Playing): When there are too many enemies, you level up too quickly and end up pausing constantly to level up.

--------

--------

👉 As always, I’m here to listen to your feedback, whether it’s here or on the Steam forums. 

Don’t forget to join our Discord server (you’ll find the link on the Towercore: Survivors Steam page or in the game’s main menu).


I hope you enjoy this update!

notes.title: 🔄 Towercore: Survivors V0.1.33 Update Delayed
notes.content:
📢 Update on Towercore: Survivors Version 0.1.33 🚧

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709562/c1558322267f6b0333338f951f3e0f873ebbb2ca.png[/img]

Hello, Guardians.

I wanted to let you know that update 0.1.33 will be slightly delayed this month. I’m in the process of replacing the Input System with Rewired, which will allow Towercore to be played with most gamepads and on Steam Deck without issues.

This improvement is crucial, as many players prefer using a gamepad (with all due respect to the noble keyboard enthusiasts), and I want to make sure everything works perfectly before releasing the new version. That’s why I need more time to test and fine-tune all the details.

I really appreciate your patience. I hope to have the new version ready soon!

Thank you for your support. 💙

— Cody

notes.title: Towercore: Survivors update, version 0.1.31, is now available!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, today I bring you some exciting news!

⚔️First of all, version 0.1.31 of Towercore: Survivors is now available! This update focuses on improving the gameplay experience by addressing some of the issues you've provided feedback on.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709562/308bc3d527d7642011c6037482589c36361f8bc3.png[/img]

🗓️Changelog:
- New Feature: 1 new level (Level 3)
- New Feature: New languages (Chinese, Korean and Japanese)
- Bug 89: (Trailer) The gameplay in the trailer is textured.
- Bug 109: (Tutorial) Add the RT/LT buttons for pause on Xbox controllers and the PS4 controller buttons (Fire1, Fire2, Fire3, Jump).
- Bug 110: (Credits) Add the missing credits.
- Bug 112: (Visions) Replace the bomb explosion with something similar that doesn’t sound like a bomb.
- Bug 113: (Idle) Disable the mouse because it’s confusing.
- Bug 115: (Mouse) Remove the accept button click.
- Bug 116: (Music) Change the music; don’t keep the same track playing all the time.
- Bug 117: (Input Lag Menu) Check the input lag in the menu.
- Bug 118: (Improvement Menu) Correct the bomb description.
- Bug 119: (Studio, Publisher, Idle...) If you press ESC, the program closes. Add a "Are you sure? Yes/No" menu.
- Bug 120: (Options, Roadmap...) Pressing ESC should return to the Idle menu.
- Bug 121: (Story) The text moves too quickly.
- Bug 125: (Playing) Bug: Invulnerability after closing the level-up panel.
- Bug 127: (Playing) There’s noticeable lag in the menus.
- Bug 142: (Playing) Input lag is noticeable, more significant with a controller than with the keyboard.
- Bug 147: (Playing - Buy Skill) Finally, in the skill purchase menu, it would be nice if the ESC button closed the menu.
- Minor bugfixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709562/e1143b7fc3153f7f8deb340b750c6d426eea1f9a.png[/img]

These are all the changes in version 0.1.31. In a few weeks, I plan to release another update focusing on controls, new Powers/weapons and new levels. I hope you enjoy this update!

👉 As always, I’m here to listen to your feedback, whether it’s here or on the Steam forums. Don’t forget to join our Discord server (you’ll find the link on the Towercore: Survivors Steam page or in the game’s main menu).

Merry Christmas and a happy new year,

CodyGameDev

notes.title: TOWERCORE: Survivors is now available!
notes.content:
Hello!


I am happy to announce that TOWERCORE: Survivors is now available!

The dark creatures are coming, and you are the only obstacle to stop them.

Discover what is the origin of the monsters to find a way to stop them.

Remember to give us a review, it helps us a lot.


Thanks and enjoy the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709562/3fabcdc82bb1cc7599bcd58c4918c7bc8765f780.png[/img]

Towercore: Survivors is a challenging dark fantasy survival game with minimalistic gameplay and roguelite elements.

The dark creatures are coming, and you are the only obstacle to stop them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709562/56d22109085c1985db6688ccb1aca67f010a2a1c.png[/img]

Discover what is the origin of the monsters to find a way to stop them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709562/804944a894a49ceb4443ff5c3e0507ca5edb5847.png[/img]

[b]Features:[/b]

- Collect weapons and magical items 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709562/ada3aae47676865e388e6565eb70cd17b28129c0.png[/img]

- Level up to become more and more powerful!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709562/cb621283e7474290b50e34cfc150f098de2859c7.png[/img]
 
- 15 achievements 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709562/9a742e299c615c91093f25bc4266a8648e9cb995.png[/img]
 
- 45 Collectibles

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709562/cd99efefc9c6efba6895747072821cea57a105cf.png[/img]

Roadmap 2024

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709562/00fe679bc90be978b86d383a823dafecadd0fcaa.png[/img]

Roadmap 2025

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709562/906c6fef0d77446238febdedede0641a4303920a.png[/img]

[b]Why Early Access?[/b]
The current state of the game is that the basic structure has been developed, and there is a list of pending improvements to be implemented in the coming months.

Early Access will be used to involve players in the development process, primarily to gather suggestions and feedback on which new features should be added to the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709562/741a0766be73f7e9beac52768d9f642276a93a00.png[/img]

[b]Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?[/b]

Towercore will be in Early Access for one year and three months, but possibly longer depending on how the design develops with player feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709562/b2dd780142bdeb505f6b2554a70460d9e000552b.png[/img]

[b]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/b]

The full version of Towercore is planned to include more weapons/powers, enemies, bosses, additional levels, and multiple endings.

List of proposed improvements (not yet developed):
- Full controller support: currently not working properly.
- Steam achievements: unlockable Steam achievements.
- Localization: Translate the game into three additional languages.
- Missions: additional missions per level to earn extra rewards at the end of the level.
- Monster info section: detailed information about each monster in the game (description, origin, weakness, damage points).
- Chronology section: a timeline of events to help the player understand the complete story.
- Tower hall levels: playable levels that expand the story.
- Tower building section: to rebuild the tower and earn extra rewards (coins, health recovery, experience points).
- Statistics section: to display statistical data at the end of each level.
- Map section: a map to provide additional information to the player.
- Sprite Redesign: Improve the visual quality of all game sprites.
- Migration to Xbox.
- Migration to PlayStation.
- Migration to Nintendo Switch.
- Save System: Implement an automatic backup system to prevent data loss in case the save file gets corrupted.
- Collectibles Improvements: Allow documents to be opened directly from the collectibles screen and automatically display the content of collected items on-screen to enhance story immersion.
- Art: Improve the game's illustrations (Steam thumbnail, Idle screen, Story screen, and Visions screen).
- Art: Update images on the Steam page, replacing static PNGs with animated GIFs and high-quality videos.
- Code Security: Encrypt the game's source code for greater security.
- Input System: Replace the current input system with the REWIRED library from Unity Assets.
- Options Screen: Expand configurable options (volume, resolution, graphic quality, and more).
- Press Kit: Create a professional Press Kit to distribute to media outlets and content creators.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709562/0aa8da4b0940bd8c4b8b9b4aea36e84ccdc7c3ca.png[/img]

[b]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/b]

The Early Access version is playable, but the game is still in development and there is a list of pending improvements.

Current status:
02 / 10 Available levels.
20 / 20 Weapons and Powers.
01 / 04 Bosses.
15 / 15 Achievements.
45 / 45 Collectibles.
15 / 15 Basic features.
00 / 22 Proposed improvements.
00 / ?? New features suggested by players.

Additionally, there are balance issues, and there are likely still bugs and CTDs (Crash to Desktop errors) that I am working on fixing.

All Towercore translations are still being tested and improved.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44709562/4ba8b7362dfaf83d97011036b3d89a69c13dfe50.png[/img]

[b]How are you planning on involving the Community in your development process?[/b]

The community will participate through my Discord server, where they can vote and suggest new improvements and ideas directly to me.

All feedback, suggestions, and bug reports are welcome.

And you can help to improve this game during the Early Access, just join to my Discord channel:
